_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 44: 24-31 January 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He notes it is January the 30th or 31st and the third is next week, and says everything the Lord said points to major decisions concerning Iran and Israel, how Israel will be handled and how Gaza will be handled.
mentions.quote: these are major decisions concerning Iran concerning Israel
mentions.falsify_match: Major American decisions on Iran, Israel or Gaza around 3 February 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Sixth distinct thing attached to that date.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told she will come on the platforms provided and be a testimony to the whole world that he is still a healer, and says he has not seen the full manifestation of that but he sees fruit.
mentions.quote: Have I seen the full manifestation of that? No. But I see fruit
mentions.falsify_match: A documented healing testified publicly.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He states outright that the full manifestation has not arrived, which is worth crediting.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls that in 2023 the Lord said a virus worse than COVID was coming that would kill over three hundred and fifty million just in this area, and clarifies that he means all of Canada and Mexico and going through South America, not only America.
mentions.quote: a virus worse than COVID was coming and it would kill over 350 million
mentions.falsify_match: A pandemic killing over 350 million across the Americas.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He widens the geography here, which lowers the implied death rate for any one country.

mentions.claim_text: He says that by January it will spread, that they will start to shut down air travel and all state to state travel, that Trump will shut it down, and that he said Trump would be president during this timeframe and he saw him.
mentions.quote: they'll start to shut down air travel. They'll shut down all state-to-state travel
mentions.falsify_match: Domestic travel restrictions imposed during an epidemic while this president is in office.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such restrictions. Which January is not given here.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was troubled because he wondered whether they tried to release it early or had already done it, since he saw they had more time to prepare, and points at the rats and the four horsemen.
mentions.quote: Did they try to release it early? I saw we had more time to prepare
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the mechanism by which a timing miss becomes an early release rather than an error.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says a woman was highlighted to him to pray over, asks whether she made it and answers no she did not, and says that in his own personal opinion he believes it was a miss, while asking who he is to say.
mentions.quote: Did she make it? No, she didn't. I believe it was a miss
mentions.falsify_match: An admitted miss, in his own words, with a concrete outcome behind it. Rare and it counts.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He declares from Psalm 91 that a thousand may fall at their side and ten thousand at their right hand but it shall not come near them, and that they shall only be a spectator, themselves inaccessible.
mentions.quote: ONLY A SPECTATOR. ONLY A SPECTATOR
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and worth noting against the plague material: the audience is exempted from the deaths being forecast.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that clear into November, even with the red wave everybody believes they have an opportunity to have, it will not be that, and that he has seen they will barely keep the House and lose the Senate.
mentions.quote: we are just barely going to keep the house that we lose the Senate
mentions.falsify_match: Republicans hold the House narrowly and lose the Senate in 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Any other split. This is the most specific electoral call in the corpus and it contradicts red-wave-2026 directly.

mentions.claim_text: He says that going into the third of February there are major decisions to be made, and that the speech he gives at the state of the union will make or break the rest of his term depending on what he says, how he stands and how he handles things.
mentions.quote: the speech he gives at the state of the union will make or break
mentions.falsify_match: A State of the Union address on 3 February 2026 that visibly changes the administration's standing.
mentions.falsify_miss: No address that day, or no change. Make or break covers both outcomes, so only the date itself is a real commitment.

mentions.claim_text: He says the man was slithering, which he says is usually how a demon possessed person moves, and that he then saw Macron with something black cracking all around him and fire coming up around him.
mentions.quote: he was slithering like this. That's usually how a demon possessed person does
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an accusation of demonic possession against a named head of state.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says God is about to restore limbs and grow out eyes, ears, noses, teeth and hair, that it will be supernatural body parts, and gives the example of someone told by a doctor that a kidney must come out.
mentions.quote: eyes and ears growing out, nose growing out, teeth coming back in
mentions.falsify_match: A verified case of limb or organ regrowth, which would be extraordinary evidence.
mentions.falsify_miss: None verified. No date is attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says he knows a lot of people are ready to go but they are not, that the Lord has more time and they have a work to do, that he has given them a window, and asks what they will do with the window, saying he sees 2028.
mentions.quote: He's given us a window. What will you do with the window?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a window with work in it and no stated end condition.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says it was a financial border rather than no border, that their currency became their currency, and that they still had borders but the American, Canadian and Mexican currencies became one, and that this is what he has been praying over.
mentions.quote: Mexico's currency became one
mentions.falsify_match: A shared North American currency.
mentions.falsify_miss: None appears. He is careful to say the borders remain, which is a real narrowing of the claim.

mentions.claim_text: They note he talked about October and November too, that they have had these cues for praying over the weather and this storm that happened, and he says he believes they prayed over it and saw results.
mentions.quote: I believe we prayed over it and we saw results
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a storm that happened is the word fulfilled, and a storm reduced is the prayer working.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He asks what the lynchpin is that pushes it over into the rapture of the church, and answers war, rumours of war and plague, naming the plague he has seen coming in 2028 and the spring and fall of 2027.
mentions.quote: what is the lynch pin that pushes this over? war, rumors of war, plague
mentions.falsify_match: War and plague in that window followed by the rapture.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. War and rumours of war are permanently satisfied, so only the plague half carries weight.

mentions.claim_text: He says God is able to replenish and bring it in, that it could not have been there and then suddenly the oil goes, and asks how in the world, answering that it is only God.
mentions.quote: the oil goes and you go, How in the world? It's only God
mentions.falsify_match: A new oil discovery in a field thought empty.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. No place is named.

mentions.claim_text: He says that given what happened in 2020 and all the major signs, anyone looking at it in 2020 would automatically say they were in the last days, and compares it to looking back from now or from 2000.
mentions.quote: you would automatically say we are in the last last days in 2020
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and unusually self-aware: he is noting that every generation reads its own moment as the last days.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he believes the effectual fervent prayers of the righteous avail much, calls them to take communion, and notes there was not much news today before turning to the underground chatter item.
mentions.quote: Those effectual fervent prayers of the righteous are going to avail much
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they are speaking things that are evil and have a reprobate mind, that the Bible says take no counsel from the ungodly, that reprobate mind people are speaking to him, and that this is why godly prayer counsel must be put around him.
mentions.quote: you've got the reprobate mind people speaking to him
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a judgment about unnamed advisers' spiritual state.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says a great shaking is still going to take place in Minnesota, even at a lower level, that there is great corruption, and that the Lord says he is going to do the same thing in California where a great shaking will take place.
mentions.quote: A great shaking is still going to take place in Minnesota
mentions.falsify_match: Corruption cases surfacing in Minnesota and California.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Shaking is undefined and no date is attached.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying he has dealt with the church concerning corruption in it and that all through 2025 he gave great warning to come up and thrive, but that a great shaking is coming to churches in California.
mentions.quote: a great shaking is coming to churches in California
mentions.falsify_match: Californian church scandals or closures.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Narrows church-cleansing to a state for the first time.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees the number 2030 and hears that it is the agenda 2030, that it is pulling down, that Trump is trying to resist it, and that this is why they pray for his safety.
mentions.quote: I see the number 2030 and I hear that's the agenda 2030
mentions.falsify_match: Sustainable development goals advancing to 2030 as a coordinated programme, which is a published UN timetable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a: the agenda he names is a real and public document with that date on it.

mentions.claim_text: He asks the Father to help him see further, says he sees what he is being shown but is trying to look over there, and says he sees the agenda 2030 and he sees the plague.
mentions.quote: I see the agenda 2030. I see the plague
mentions.falsify_match: The two joined: a plague used to advance the agenda.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He does not say how they connect, only that he sees both.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that they hold back the agenda of 2030 in Jesus' name with the blood of the lamb, and declares they will have the greatest revival across this land, that their nation will have a great revival and that Australia will too.
mentions.quote: We hold it back in Jesus name with the blood of the lamb
mentions.falsify_match: The agenda stalling and revivals in both countries.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. Structured so that the agenda advancing means insufficient prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when he was looking into the Olympics over these next two weeks there is so much purple, and notes that followers of the channel know he sees colours.
mentions.quote: looking into the Olympics, there's so much purple
mentions.falsify_match: Something at the Winter Olympics.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing. Purple is never given a meaning, here or in purple-three-mountain.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are almost into the Olympics, which start not this Friday but the next, that the Lord said to pray over the third, and asks them to come back and pray over the Olympics with him.
mentions.quote: the Lord said to pray over the third
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at or around the games.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He now has the games starting the following Friday, 6 February, which is right, though the third is still the date he prays over.

mentions.claim_text: He says they may remember that the old will cry, and that he saw graves, repeating it, saw graves across the land in Europe eight times, and saw an uprising and war.
mentions.quote: I saw graves across the land in Europe. I saw an uprising and war
mentions.falsify_match: Mass deaths and war in Europe.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The eight is a count of how many times he saw it, not of anything in the world.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is bigger than the world has ever seen before and that God is calling all of them to come up higher in their prayer life, and repeats that 1 Corinthians 5:5 was the word of the Lord for 2026, noting a lot of people did not understand.
mentions.quote: 1 Corinthians 5:5 was the word of the Lord for 2026
mentions.falsify_match: Ministers or public figures visibly handed over during 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Fourth telling of the same verse claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says America did not look the same, asks whether the man is the saviour and answers no, that the only person who will save America is the Lord Jesus Christ though he will use individuals, and that when they get too big headed things change.
mentions.quote: The only person who will save America is the Lord Jesus Christ
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and worth recording: it puts distance between him and the political figure he otherwise promotes.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the Psalm 91 promise that nothing shall come near them, tells them to humble themselves under the mighty hand of God so that in due time he will exalt them, and says they are in the time of the valley of decision coming into November.
mentions.quote: you're in the time of the valley of decision coming into November
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a valley of decision running to the midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a
